problems: Elenchus column block is detached and nearly all numbers are lost ('19 1211 1235' only); 10 of 14 entries are body-only.
Body page numbers 2-11 and 53-60 are lost in the OCR; cols for Expositio Symboli (9) and the Alexias title/Possini dedication (59) rest on the Ordo.
Ordo columns for the 15 books of the Alexias are mostly garbled, so no parts array was made.
Elenchus lists In Adorationem zonae among Euthymius's works, but the body prints it as ADDENDA at col ≈1244 (end of volume).
Dialogus Christiani cum Ismaelita (col ≈33-38) and Haeschelii Epistola nuncupatoria (col 70) are in the body and Ordo but have no separate Elenchus line; noted under their neighbours.
